commits.subject: Keep plan item IDs unique after completion (#61186)
commits.reason: Unique completed plan IDs are correct, but the new unfinished_plan_id is local to run_turn and starts empty. ALab suspends a live child task and restores a new task from its captured context. Without an owned captured unfinished ID, a plan started before transfer receives a new UUID on restoration. Preserve the exact unfinished ID across retries and native transfer, clear it after completion, and allocate a new ID for a subsequent plan.
evidence: Reviewed d0221bc94711 actual four-file diff: run_turn introduces Option<String>; run_sampling_request/try_run_sampling_request forward it; PlanModeStreamState reuses only an unfinished ID and otherwise allocates UUIDv7; finished state retires the ID.

Concrete compile adaptations: alab-core/glue/terminal_steering_tests.rs calls run_sampling_request at the two sampling helpers and must supply the new mutable argument without weakening refusal/cancellation assertions.

Concrete transfer seam: exec_child_suspension.rs removes/cancels the active task then captures recovery options; exec_model_context.rs, exec_sampling_progress.rs and exec_input_batch.rs do not store an unfinished plan ID. A new run_turn therefore loses an in-flight plan identity that the old turn-derived ID preserved.

Required upstream checks: turn_tests.rs::plan_attempts_only_reuse_unfinished_item_ids; app-server plan_item.rs::plan_mode_uses_proposed_plan_block_for_plan_item; core items.rs::plan_mode_keeps_only_unfinished_ids_across_model_requests.

Required new ALab integration regression (proposed name): exec_handoff_preserves_only_an_unfinished_plan_id. Start and partially emit a plan, suspend and restore the same turn, require identical start/delta/completion ID, then require a distinct next plan ID; cover snapshot validation and retirement. Keep identity/lifecycle in ALab-owned code with only marked upstream hooks. Retain all terminal_steering_tests refusal/overload/interrupt cases. No tests executed.
commits.revisit: This adaptation is required before qualification: prove exact unfinished identity is captured before emitted plan events, survives transfer, and is retired after completion. SourceV1 activation remains held.
